d: Short, swept-back ash blonde hair with long bangs framing the face, paired with narrow, focused gold eyes and a mature, adult facial expression. The build is lean and athletic, dressed in a blue and navy western-style outfit featuring a long dark cape with gold star accents, a blue tunic with a brown utility belt, matching navy trousers, and tall brown boots with gold spurs. Signature details include a brown wide-brimmed cowboy hat adorned with a dark feather and gold stars, brown leather gloves, and a large, oversized golden mechanical rifle.
